title: Pro-etale unbounded closed-support tensor projection
statement: Let i:Z → T be a closed immersion with complementary quasi-compact open j:U → T. Let R be any commutative ring sheaf on T_proet and R_Z=i^{-1}R. Use the actual recorded proetale derived pullback p and right-derived direct image q, with identity coefficient identification. With native derived tensors [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor] there is a natural isomorphism q(N) tensor_T K ≅ q(N tensor_Z p(K)), natural simultaneously in every N in D(R_Z) and K in D(R). There is no boundedness, Tor, finiteness or constancy assumption on complexes or coefficients, and no exceptional adjoint or dualizing object appears.

proof.text: Identify the actual scalar-unit direct image with ringed direct image by the identity coefficient map. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies their inverse images. Ringed open/closed localization supplies exact closed direct image, invertible counit and complementary-open vanishing; open/closed zero detection supplies joint reflection.

Pass the exact adjunction and counit to the unbounded derived categories by the termwise localization construction. Use homology comparisons to transfer complementary-open vanishing and joint reflection. The proof imports the proved localization helpers of the ringed closed-kernel adjoint module, without using its exceptional-adjoint conclusion.
Specialize canonical derived tensor pullback to the native tensor models using their natural flat-representative comparisons. Do this for both the closed and open inverse images.

For X = q(N) tensor K, apply joint reflection to the unit X → qp(X). Its closed restriction is invertible by the adjunction triangle and invertible counit. Its open restriction has zero source and target, by tensor pullback, cross-vanishing and preservation of zero by tensor as a left adjoint. Thus the unit is invertible. Whisker this natural unit with the closed tensor comparison and counit to obtain q(N) tensor K ≅ q(N tensor p(K)). Transport the exact direct-image descent to its right-derived presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleClosedTensorProjection
    {T Z U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    let RZ := (proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R
    let tT := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} (ProEt.topology T) R)
    let tZ := @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _
      (RingedDerivedNative.monoidal.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} (ProEt.topology Z) RZ)
    Nonempty ((proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage i R RZ (Iso.refl _)).prod (𝟭 _) ⋙ tT ≅
      (𝟭 _).prod (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback i R RZ (Iso.refl _)) ⋙ tZ ⋙
        proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage i R RZ (Iso.refl _))
